text:
My dear, the world is
so inexpressibly boring.

There is no telepathy there, no ghosts,
No flying saucers.
They cannot exist.
Cast-iron laws govern the world.
These laws have not been violated.
They simply cannot be broken.

I don't count on flying saucers. 
That would be too interesting.
But what about the Bermuda Triangle?

You aren't going to contradict ...
- Yes, I am.
There is no Bermuda Triangle there.
There is a triangle ABC,

which equals
Triangle A Prime, B Prime, C Prime.
It's all so tiring, so tiring.
In the Middle Ages, life was interesting.

Every house had its own goblin,
Every church had a God.

People were young.
Now every fourth person is old.
It's boring, my angel. It's so boring.
But you said that the zone is a product of a super-civilization -

Which is probably just as boring,
The same with laws and triangles,

But without goblins
And, of course, without God.
Because if there is a God, He will be such a triangle.
Then I just don't know.
This is for me. Goodbye, dear friend.
This beautiful lady agreed to go with us into the zone.
She is so brave. Her name is -
Excuse me, what is your name?
Are you really a stalker?
I'll explain everything later.
To get lost.
Idiot.
So, did you drink?

I just had a drink,
Like half of all humanity.
And the other half is also drunk, including women and children.
I just had a drink.
